<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
const props = defineProps<{ title: string }>()
const n = ref(0)
const label = computed(() => `${props.title}: ${n.value}`)
</script>

<template>
  <button :class="{ on: n > 0 }" @click="n++" v-if="title">{{ label }}</button>
  <ul v-else><li v-for="i in 3" :key="i">{{ i }}</li></ul>
</template>

<style scoped>
button { color: red }
</style>
